answer: We define a protocol where agents deposit staking collateral into a dynamic bond subjected to zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions to secure identity registration. Under this lotus architecture, any attempt to forge multiple valid identities incurs exponential slashing penalties, driving the expected utility of a Sybil attack below zero. The resulting subgame-perfect punishment matrix creates a canyon between honest validation payoffs and adversarial losses, establishing a unique, strictly dominant Nash equilibrium.
